# 100 USD bought into an account typed Stock but denominated in USD.
#
# The account type is a classification; what decides whether a split holds
# foreign currency is its commodity, and this one's is USD in the CURRENCY
# namespace. A book can be laid out this way, and the currency in it is held,
# sellable and taxable like any other.
#
# What this fixture produces: `fx-balances` lists 100.00 USD at 1.35 CAD/USD.
# Judging by account type instead — dropping Stock and Mutual Fund from the
# debit-side types because a securities account "cannot" hold a currency —
# leaves this book reporting no cost basis at all.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_securities_are_not_currency.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Held
	type: Stock
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Held 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
